summary.text: Kim Carver is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 89, which the legislature's member page lists as covering St. Tammany Parish. First elected in 2023, Kim Carver sits on the Commerce, Education, and Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs committees and the House Executive Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Kim Carver's occupation as banker, with a B.S. in engineering from Louisiana State University and an M.B.A. from the University of New Orleans.

The House page lists Kim Carver's committee assignments as Commerce, Education, Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs, and House Executive Committee, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and Northshore Delegation.
